output.one_liner: Jira is a cloud-based project management platform for planning, tracking, and managing software team work.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) is the recommended method for apps, with account-level or resource-level grant options. API tokens enable basic auth. All managed in the Atlassian developer console.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) allows external applications and services to access Atlassian product APIs on a user's behalf.
Basic auth requires API tokens. You generate an API token for your Atlassian account and use it to authenticate.

access.notes: Free Atlassian Cloud development sites provided. API tokens self-generated by any account owner. OAuth apps created and configured in developer console without approval process documented.

evidence.snippet: The Cloud Developer Bundle provides a free Atlassian cloud development site for building and testing apps.
OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps are created and managed in the developer console.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Points-based hourly quota (130k–150k base plus 20–30 per user), burst limits per endpoint and method, per-issue write limits. Global or per-tenant pools available.

evidence.snippet: Issues, Projects, Workflows, Users, Filters, Dashboards, Webhooks, Screens, Permissions, Audit records - 50+ resource types with hundreds of endpoints.
A webhook is a user-defined callback over HTTPS. Register webhooks via REST API with optional JQL filtering.
Points-based rate limiting, burst API rate limits, per-issue write limits. Tiered quotas by edition: Free, Standard, Premium, Enterprise.

buildability.rationale: Jira has a comprehensive REST API with 50+ resources, self-serve OAuth and API token credentials, free developer sandboxes, webhooks support, and an existing Composio toolkit with 171 tools already built.

overview_evidence.snippet: Jira Cloud is built for every member of your software team to plan, track, and manage their work.
Category: project management. Auth: OAUTH2, S2S_OAUTH2, API_KEY. Tools: 171. Composio-managed OAuth available? Yes.

unknown_reasons.mcp: Provided pages do not mention any official or community MCP servers for Jira.
